blocks.html: Before computers, a letter with a mistake had to be typed again from the beginning on a typewriter. A word processor lets you type, correct, format, save and print text as many times as you like.
Definition: A word processor is application software used to create, edit, format, save and print text documents such as letters, applications, reports, notices and books.
Examples: Microsoft Word, LibreOffice Writer (free), Google Docs (online) and WordPad/Notepad (simple editors).

items.html: Line spacing — 1.0, 1.5, 2.0; paragraph spacing before and after.
Indent — moves a paragraph away from the margin; first-line indent moves only the first line.
Bullets and numbering — for lists.
Borders and shading — boxes and background colour around paragraphs.
Styles — ready-made formats such as Heading 1 and Title; using them lets Word build a table of contents automatically.
Margins — blank space around the page (Normal = 1 inch on each side).
Orientation — Portrait (tall) or Landscape (wide).
Size — A4 is the standard paper size in India.
Columns — two or three columns, as in a newsletter.
Breaks — a page break (Ctrl + Enter) starts a new page.
Header and footer (Insert tab) — text at the top or bottom of every page, such as the school name.
Page numbers (Insert tab).
Watermark (Design tab) — faint text such as CONFIDENTIAL or DRAFT behind the text.

Suppose the principal wants to send an Annual Day invitation to 200 parents, each with the parent's and student's name. Typing 200 letters would take days. Mail Merge does it in minutes.
Mail Merge combines two things:

items.html: Main document — the letter text that is the same for everyone.
Data source — a list (in Excel or Word) of the details that change: names, classes, addresses.

blocks.html: Steps: Mailings → Start Mail Merge → Letters → Select Recipients → Use an Existing List (choose the Excel file) → place the cursor and click Insert Merge Field (e.g. «Parent_Name», «Student_Name», «Class») → Preview Results → Finish & Merge → Edit Individual Documents or Print Documents.
Mail Merge is also used for certificates, admit cards, salary slips and envelopes.

Press Ctrl + P to open the print screen. It shows a print preview on the right. Choose the printer, the number of copies, the pages (for example 1-3, 5), single- or double-sided printing and the paper size, and then click Print.
Did you know? You can type in Hindi in Word by adding a Hindi keyboard in Windows Settings. Unicode fonts such as Nirmala UI and Mangal display Devanagari correctly on every computer.

A word processor creates, edits, formats, saves and prints documents; MS Word, LibreOffice Writer and Google Docs are examples.
The Word window has a title bar, Quick Access Toolbar, ribbon with tabs and groups, ruler, document area and status bar.
Editing tools include cut, copy, paste, undo, redo, find and replace and spell check.
Character formats: font, size, bold, italic, underline, colour, subscript, superscript; paragraph formats: alignment, spacing, indents, bullets.
Page layout covers margins, orientation, size, columns, breaks, headers, footers and page numbers.
Tables, pictures, shapes, SmartArt, symbols and equations can be inserted.
Mail Merge joins a main document with a data source to produce personalised letters.
